Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class ViewDef

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.ViewDef
public final class ViewDef extends Object
A datatable view definition — an ordered set of Column definitions carrying each column's search configuration. This is the bean the VIEW_META search block is serialized from.

A view may also carry a table-level SearchOperatorSet: it is inherited by every column that does not supply its own set (see Column.effectiveOperators(SearchOperatorSet) and Column.searchMeta(SearchOperatorSet)). A column that supplies its own set entirely replaces the table-level set for that column.

Mutability

Deliberately mutable, like Column and RegionDef: a ViewDef is a server-side authoring bean built up once via fluent setters and column(Column) calls while constructing a view, not an immutable value object. Callers must not mutate one concurrently from more than one thread, and must not reuse one across requests unless every request treats it as read-only after construction.

Example:

// A view with a table-level $eq-only default, and one column ("status") that replaces it with $in-only. ViewDef view = ViewDef.create("releases") .operators(SearchOperatorSet.of(SearchOperatorSet.standard().get("$eq"))) .column(Column.create("name").label("Name").searchType(SearchType.TEXT)) .column(Column.create("status").label("Status").searchType(SearchType.ID) .operators(SearchOperatorSet.of(SearchOperatorSet.standard().get("$in"))));
